authoritative_data: The desktop owns disposable widgets and local layout/shortcut preferences. Document edits are versioned requests through DesktopClient; no window owns engineering authority.

input_output: create_desktop_window(DesktopClient::Options) returns caller-owned QMainWindow*; caller owns Qt event loop. desktop_pipeline_idle(const QMainWindow&) observes pipeline state without draining events or sending requests.

QSettings("QCAE","Desktop") persists panel layout in private desktop.cpp; shortcut_preferences.cpp persists action bindings. Public desktop.hpp exposes factory/run/observation APIs, not a preference service.
